scope: Static source audit only; no live GC plan/execute/resume, object mutation, deletion, repair, ref change or new fixture.

paths.observation: Object path/content and catalog metadata are updated without an ObjectStore-wide mutation lock; caller synchronization varies. Existing put preserves old file mtime; repair replaces content and refreshes metadata.
Ordinary append writes objects and publishes ref under sync.refs Python plus refs-file locks, after a parent fence.
Merge/resolution object construction occurs before advance_ref takes the ref locks. advance_ref fences the head publication, not the entire prepublication object lifetime.
Object imports call has/put individually, before subsequent head reconciliation/publication. There is no encompassing ref lock in ingest_objects itself.
Recovery DOES take the log Python/file ref fence and recheck head before ObjectStore.repair. Do not describe every repair caller as unfenced.
Registry changes use their own RLock. Epoch object put occurs before registry.record_epoch. GC execute does not reread this current registry or the required-ack policy.

Plan collects local reachability and convergence peer tips outside the future execute. Execute authorizes a request realm, then passes only plan_id/confirm to GcPlanner.execute; it does not pass the authorized realm or recompute current pins/head inputs.
Execution trusts saved reclaimable/ack flags and candidate list, releases the journal lock before callbacks, and never consults current epoch/head/pins/realm metadata. Resume repeats that executor.

limits: This is not an exhaustive inventory of all publication, backup pins, import or administrative callers.
No production GC usage, deletion, cross-realm exploit, loss or causal latency is established.
Prior disposable refreshed-metadata delete-spy admission remains the only behavioral observation; zero object bytes were deleted.
A timestamp-only reread or a ref-only lock does not by itself establish safety for all writers/epoch/pin changes. Lock order and bounded hold cost remain unvalidated.
next: Keep metadata batching unimplemented. Establish one publication/mutation generation contract, current authorized plan realm, epoch/ack policy, reachability and pin freshness across execute/resume, then test interleavings with disposable delete spies before any optimization or deployed GC. Preserve canonical durability and avoid long history walks under the ref fence.
